profile.name: Cytomat自动化微孔板培养存储系统
profile.description: 该设备是实验室自动化流程中的微孔板培养与存储一体机，可在受控温度、CO2、O2和湿度条件下保存和培养板件，并通过内部机械传送机构在存储位、等待位、转运位和外部暴露位之间自动转移微孔板，支持条码读取与振荡培养。
profile.description_en: This device is an automated microplate incubator and storage unit for laboratory workflows. It maintains controlled temperature, CO2, O2, and humidity conditions, and uses internal handling mechanics to move plates between storage, wait, transfer, and exposed positions. It also supports barcode reading and shaking incubation.
